description: Use when asked which customers or prospects are growing or shrinking, e.g. "Of my 300 customers, which ones have been shrinking for two years?" Growth trajectory of a French legal entity from its filed accounts ONLY: trajectoire in a closed list (croissance_forte, croissance_moderee, stable, degradation_apres_croissance, repli_modere, repli_marque, volatil_sans_tendance, serie_trop_courte, non_evaluable) on the last 4 fiscal years kept, the latest closed within 24 months, with the revenue series, peak and drop; non_evaluable carries cause_non_evaluable (aucun_compte_publie, comptes_inexploitables, comptes_trop_anciens, chiffre_affaires_non_publie), billed. signaux_hors_comptes gives establishments opened and closed over 24 months, DECP publications of contracts notified over the last 12 months vs the 12 before (an upper bound, like nombre_marches of /v1/entreprise/{siren}/marches-publics, with the source's own volume as a benchmark) and the headcount band, as dated facts, never a verdict. critere_de_liste gives the snapshot value of the tendances.trajectoire criterion of query_french_companies, which screens a whole customer file by lists of 50 SIRENs. A sole proprietor or restricted entity is refused (400, not charged); unknown SIREN 404, not charged. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). Closed lists and reading rules: GET /v1/lecture (free). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

siren.description: 9-digit SIREN of a French legal entity

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
